template/model#

The strings a text template is filled with.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

TemplateBindings(["user.name": "Ada"]);
TemplateBindings(TemplateBinding(path: TemplatePath("user", "name"), value: "Ada"));

Description#

The strings a text template is filled with.

A value is looked up by its exact path; MissingTemplateValue when absent. Values are plain strings: no objects, no reflection.

The bindings are one Json document (#178), the data model of template/engine: user.name is member name of member user. A path that is a value and also leads to others (a and a.b) has no such document and is DuplicateTemplateValue, like a path given twice; both are found in one pass.
